subject: Remove duplicate macro definitions of HASH_SET_* (#2024)
reason: The change only deletes duplicate #define lines for HASH_SET_TAKE_FIELD, HASH_SET_TAKE_VALUE and HASH_SET_COPY from t_hash.c; identical definitions with the same values remain in server.h (lines 3268-3270), so preprocessing, hashTypeSet and all hash commands compile to exactly the same code. A pure refactor with no behavior change needs no scenario.
